semiconductor_relevance: High — Caelus Technologies Limited specializes in high-performance data-converting solutions, which are essential for modern semiconductor applications.
summary: Caelus Technologies Limited is a fabless semiconductor design company that focuses on disruptive Data Converter System on Chip (SoC) solutions. Their technology transforms real-world analogue signals into precise, high-speed digital information, catering to high-value sectors such as instrumentation, communications, and healthcare.
